product_description: Bring traditional elegance to your home with this handcrafted toran, featuring vibrant peacock motifs, pink lotus accents, sacred cow designs, and intricate golden detailing. Finished with pearl strings and decorative tassels, it is perfect for festive entrances, pooja rooms, Diwali, and special celebrations.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and direct sunlight.
Handle the pearl strings and tassels with care.
Store in a dry place in protective packaging after use.
